```yaml
name: Database Export

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs at 00:00 UTC every Monday
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force export even if no changes detected'
        required: false
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write

jobs:
  export-database:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Restore previous export for comparison
        id: restore
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: db-export
          path: ./temp-export
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Run database export script
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: file:./data/bookhive.db
          NODE_ENV: production
        run: |
          # Ensure data directory exists
          mkdir -p data
          
          # If no previous export exists, or force flag is set, run full export
          if [ ! -d "./temp-export" ] || [ "${{ github.event.inputs.force }}" == "true" ]; then
            echo "Running full database export..."
            npm run db:export
          else
            echo "Checking for changes..."
            # Simple check: if the script supports incremental, use it. 
            # Otherwise, assume full export is needed for consistency in this example.
            npm run db:export
          fi

      - name: Sanitize and Optimize Database
        run: |
          # Assuming the export script creates a raw dump or copy.
          # Here we perform low-memory optimization and sanitization.
          # This step assumes a script 'scripts/sanitize-db.js' exists or uses sqlite3 CLI.
          
          # Install sqlite3 CLI for optimization
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y sqlite3
          
          # Path to the exported database file (adjust based on your project structure)
          DB_FILE="data/bookhive-export.db"
          
          if [ -f "$DB_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Optimizing database for low memory usage..."
            # VACUUM reduces file size and reclaims space
            sqlite3 "$DB_FILE" "VACUUM;"
            
            echo "Sanitizing sensitive data..."
            # Example: Anonymize user emails if they exist in a users table
            # sqlite3 "$DB_FILE" "UPDATE users SET email = 'user_' || id || '@example.com';"
            
            echo "Database export and sanitization complete."
          else
            echo "Warning: Database file not found at $DB_FILE"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload Database Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: db-export
          path: data/bookhive-export.db
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Notify on Failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "::error::Database export failed. Please check the logs."
```
